sources.entry: myCart ⚠ - Shopping cart in 1 file (with support for payment by card or cryptocurrency). MIT Go/Docker

summary.one_liner: myCart is an MIT-licensed, Go-based shopping cart in a single binary with an embedded SQLite database (PostgreSQL optional), an admin dashboard, and a storefront for selling digital files, license keys, and free products.
summary.what_it_does: The project ships as one executable that runs a storefront and an admin panel built with SvelteKit and TailwindCSS. It stores data in SQLite by default or PostgreSQL if chosen at install time, and provides install, migrate, update, and db backup/restore/copy commands. Products can be physical-style items, digital files, or license keys, and products priced at 0 are processed through a built-in Dummy Payment provider. Payment providers documented in the README are Stripe, PayPal, SpectroCoin, and Coinbase Commerce, with webhooks supported. Optional customer accounts let buyers sign in to see orders, re-download files, and view license keys, and the admin panel supports branding uploads, eight interface languages, and product variants.
use_cases: run an online store selling digital downloads
accept card or crypto payments on a small shop
offer free downloads or samples to collect emails
migrate a shop from SQLite to PostgreSQL
notable: Single-file binary with embedded SQLite by default; no separate database server needed
Free products (price 0) automatically use a built-in Dummy Payment provider
Opt-in customer accounts with a buyer cabinet for re-downloading files and viewing license keys
Hardened sessions with separate keys and cookies for admin and customers, plus same-origin checks
One-command move of a shop from SQLite to PostgreSQL with dry-run and row-count verification
caveats: Version is v0.x and under active development; backward compatibility is not guaranteed before v1.0.0
The project is being renamed from litecart after a trademark claim, so names and references may change
SpectroCoin payments are not credited until callback merchant ID and API ID are configured
